items.html: Correction 8 is in the widening of the beard. And the explanation of the matter is that the beard from above is divided into two: the right side and the left side, as mentioned. And they extend to opposite the mouth, and from there and below there is no division in the beard into the two sides, for the whole is one aspect from the place of the mouth and below, and from there onward the whole is one. However, it divides in another way, and that is in its thickness. For it is entirely hairs upon hairs, and the side of the upper thickness of the beard, which is the revealed [part], has long hairs in it; and opposite it, on the side of the lower thickness of the beard, in the covered place, which is near the throat, there are also long hairs.
